query:
SELECT min(breaths_per_minute) AS lowest,
                (SELECT latest.breaths_per_minute
                 FROM resting_rates latest
                 WHERE latest.user_id = $1
                 ORDER BY latest.measured_at DESC, latest.client_measurement_id DESC
                 LIMIT 1) AS latest,
                count(*) AS "count!"
         FROM resting_rates
         WHERE user_id = $1
